steps.text: If the player has killed only lizardmen:

steps.npc: The Shayzien records say you've killed [X] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills.

steps.text: If the player has killed both lizardmen and lizardman shamans:

steps.npc: The Shayzien records say you've killed [X] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [X] were lizardman shamans.
